ideas.name: VIX Backwardation and S&P 500 Returns
ideas.claim: A negative VIX futures term-structure slope is associated with positive subsequent S&P 500 returns.
ideas.quote: This means that whenever the estimated VIX term structure took negative values (i.e., the VIX futures were in backwardation), the subsequent future return of S&P500 was positive.

rules.timeframe: Daily signal; subsequent returns examined over one day, one week, one month, and one quarter
rules.entry: Negative estimated VIX futures term-structure slope; exact trade entry is not stated
rules.filters: The slope is estimated daily by regressing spot VIX and the seven nearest VIX futures prices on time to maturity.

ideas.claimed_result: The negative-slope coefficient was statistically significant at three of four examined horizons, excluding the monthly horizon; the daily coefficient was -0.1687.
required_data: Daily closes and maturities of the seven nearest VIX futures contracts
